text:
Nia (Design): Dropped a tiny prototype for an inline 'suppression preview' card that appears in the Alerting flow. Idea: show active rules, local clock, and a short explanation sentence so users immediately understand why a channel won't fire. Figma: https://figma.redwood/suppression-preview-compact Theo (PM): Love the inline approach. Quick ask: can the sentence be written for non-engineers too? Ops folks will read it differently. Example copy: 'This channel is silenced by Quiet Hours until 07:00 (your local time)'. Arjun (Frontend): Implementation hint: render the sentence as a single accessible paragraph and add a `details` disclosure for rule metadata. Code pattern: `

This channel is silenced...

Why?
matching rule: quiet-window-7
` Rae (A11y): For screen readers, ensure the preview card has `role="status" aria-live="polite"` so when it appears it is announced. Also avoid relying on color to communicate state: include an icon + text. Kai (SRE): For debugging, include a tiny `lastEval` timestamp, e.g., "last evaluated 1m ago". Also show whether the preview uses the draft rules or live config. We had confusion last week during rollouts. Nia (Design): Good call. I'll add a pill: `Preview: draft @ 2024-06-18T10:32Z`. Also swapping "silenced" back to "suppressed"? Which is clearer? Theo (PM): My preference is "silenced" for short UI labels, but use the fuller verbage in SR label: `aria-label="Channel PagerDuty — suppressed by quiet window until 07:00"`. That keeps visible copy concise and accessible text explicit. Arjun (Frontend): Note about keyboard: the `details` element handles keyboard by default but we need to ensure the expand target receives focus (focusable summary). For tooltip-like extra info, prefer a controlled disclosure so we can manage focus and `aria-expanded`. Rae (A11y): Also add `aria-describedby` from the channel row to the preview card so users navigating to the row hear the reason without extra keystrokes. If the preview is toggleable, maintain focus order: row -> expand -> inside content -> close. Kai (SRE): Edge case: if suppression is due to an override at the team level (not the channel), make sure we show provenance: 'Silenced by rule: Night team override (applies to all channels)'. That helped clarify ownership in past incidents. Nia (Design): UI change: two-line microcopy under the main sentence: line 1 = provenance, line 2 = lastEval + preview mode. Visually muted. Will adjust contrast tokens for that text. Theo (PM): Tiny copy tweak: prefer 'until 07:00 local time' instead of parentheses. Also add a hover that shows the rule expression (if user has permission). Arjun (Frontend): Security note: rule expressions may contain sensitive names. Only expose the full expression when the viewing user has proper access, otherwise show 'restricted'. We'll handle via the API: `previewDetails` returns `masked:true|false`. Rae (A11y): Final check: make sure the icon has `aria-hidden="true"` and the text conveys the full status. For high-contrast themes, test color + icon combos. I'll run a small audit once the PR lands. preview-bot: preview deployed: https://preview.redwood/alerts/suppression-preview?branch=supp-preview — build ok. Nia (Design): Thanks all — I'll push updated mocks with the provenance line and adjusted copy. Please flag any regressions by EOD.
